name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-docker
description: Deployment-level Docker plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a 容器 (Containers) tab next to chat/trajectory with observe/intervene two-mode UI, 18 model tools (docker_info/ps/images/pull/run/start/stop/restart/rm/rmi/logs/exec/inspect/stats/network/volume/build/cli), read-only live shell watching, and /dock-api/* HTTP routes served via webServer.
